verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships an AI SRE agent that can be delegated tasks like investigating incidents, answering natural-language queries about logs/metrics, drafting post-mortems, suggesting fixes as GitHub PRs, and creating Linear tickets, callable from Slack, Teams, or Claude Code via MCP. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the AI SRE's task delegation beyond vendor marketing copy, and detail on the range/reliability of tasks it can autonomously complete.
